# X1 snapshot impact check: fixture-by-fixture inventory (21 Nov 2026; owner requirement B)

**How this was produced.** The table is generated by a script reading each fixture's own sheets. On the direct route, the canonical fields
(`Allocated_Qty`, `On_Order_Qty`, `Reorder_Point_Qty`, and `Unit_Cost_GBP` = CDv1 `Unit_Cost`) are the **Inventory** sheet columns of those
names, so the check uses those columns, not display labels.

**Which fixtures.** The golden snapshots (v0.5, v0.6.0) use Northstar only. The confidence snapshot and same-results use the 17 workbooks
below. The browser tests start from Northstar and apply their own cell-level edits (listed in `tests/browser-x1-chrome.js` and
`tests/test-x1-wp5.js`). Those edits are deliberate test inputs, not fixtures.

| Fixture | Used by | Inventory rows | Neg. Allocated_Qty | Neg. On_Order_Qty | Neg. Reorder_Point_Qty | Zero Unit_Cost_GBP | Blank Allocated_Qty | Text in a stock number field | Zero or invalid BOM qty | Blank/invalid/negative Units_Sold | Recorded zero months | FG with no demand rows |

**Result: no fixture matched any condition (0 records in every column).** So:
- D1(b) (zero BOM quantity), D1(d) (negatives), D7 (zero cost) and the invalid-demand rule change **no** golden or confidence result;
- no snapshot needed treatment for them.

**Conditions not shown as a table column:**

| Condition | Fixtures | Effect | Treatment |
|---|---|---|---|
| Items with missing months inside the window (D6, WP6) | `structure/scenario-willow.xlsx` only: 7 of 14 finished goods are partial, and 6 of them have internal gaps (WF-B330, WF-E110, WF-F355, WF-I957, WF-K343, WF-N525) | Willow's forecasts for those 6 change; 12 raw materials change usage through calendar alignment (Finding A); one confidence-snapshot value changes | Named approved snapshot change, Q3 / CR-20 |
| Import-route fixtures (not snapshots) | `fixtures/library/01-Clean-Manufacturer` (import I6: P0001 excluded, so M0058 has no parent demand rows) and `fixtures/import-v1/faults/F01-stock-bad-row` (one bad stock row) | Q1 and Q4 | Assertions superseded with notes (CR-17, CR-19) |
